I am a Professor of Analytics and Decision Sciences at Cardiff Business School, Cardiff University. I founded and direct the [Data Lab for Social Good](https://www.cardiff.ac.uk/research/explore/research-units/data-lab-for-social-good), and I lead the [Uncertainty & the Future](https://www.cardiff.ac.uk/digital-transformation-innovation-institute/work-with-us/uncertainty-and-the-future) theme at [DTII](https://www.cardiff.ac.uk/digital-transformation-innovation-institute), where I work closely with academic, public, and industry partners on questions that matter for society.

My work sits at the intersection of data, uncertainty, and decision-making, with a focus on how advanced analytical methods can support better choices in complex and uncertain futures. Drawing on Data Science, AI, and Operations Research (OR), I develop and apply approaches that are both methodologically rigorous and demonstrably relevant to real-world decision contexts.

So far, my contributions to the field have been recognised with two medals from the [OR Society](https://www.theorsociety.com/): the [Goodeve Medal](https://www.theorsociety.com/ORS/ORS/Membership/Awards/Medals/Goodeve-Medal.aspx) in 2024, awarded for outstanding contributions to the philosophy, theory, and practice of OR, and the [Lyn Thomas Impact Medal](https://www.theorsociety.com/ORS/ORS/Membership/Awards/Medals/Lyn-Thomas-Impact-Medal.aspx) in 2025, recognising OR academic research that combines methodological innovation with clear, evidenced real-world impact.
